notablePrerequisites: The Eternity Elevator has twenty or more charge counters on it.
description:
Activate The Eternity Elevator by tapping it, adding at least twenty mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting itself.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Voltaic Key's ability, targeting The Eternity Elevator.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and The Eternity Elevator.
Repeat.
